name: content-calendar-visuals
query: Give me a month of Instagram posts for my bakery. I need to post more.

context.conversation: Bakery name: Crumb & Co. Voice: warm and a little playful. They post rarely today. They mention having a logo but no design tool.

success_criteria: Asks at most the content-calendar questions that change the build (channels, rhythm, voice), skipping what the conversation answers; proposes a realistic rhythm labeled as proposed.
Builds a Posts database (Idea -> Drafting -> Ready -> Published) with a calendar view and a 'Needs a date' view; captions are written inside the rows, not only in chat.

Treats visuals in two steps: concepts first (built-in image generation is acceptable), and offers finished posts via Canva as one option on a card, with its description; never claims finished assets exist.
No RSVP form, site, meeting or Vercel option is offered.
Offers a recurring weekly post template or reminder as a piece, and explains the manual step if the connection can't create it.
